# Tests --output-muxt-version=false leaves the muxt version out of generated files.
#
# By default generated files record the muxt version twice: once in the
# "// muxt version:" header comment and once in the TemplateData MuxtVersion
# method. Passing --output-muxt-version=false omits both.
#
# The flag is recorded in the "Code generated by muxt generate" header so a
# later bare `muxt generate` in the same directory keeps parsing the file as
# muxt-generated output.

muxt generate --output-muxt-version=false

grep 'Code generated by muxt generate --output-muxt-version=false\. DO NOT EDIT\.' template_routes.go
! grep '// muxt version:' template_routes.go
! grep 'func.*MuxtVersion' template_routes.go

# The header comment must not become the package doc comment.
exec go doc -all .
! stdout 'Code generated by muxt generate'
! stdout 'MuxtVersion'

exec go build ./...

# The default keeps both.
muxt generate

grep 'func.*MuxtVersion' template_routes.go

exec go build ./...

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.25
-- index.gohtml --
{{define "GET /"}}
	<h1>Hello!</h1>
{{end}}
-- template.go --
package main

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSrc embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSrc, "*.gohtml"))
-- in.go --
package main

func main() {}
